crop.notes: The 'Tom Allen's Joke' subsection of a longer Mitchell training article; complete. A tear in the paper obscures a few words in one line.

ocr.notes: Transcript drops 'finally no one remained but' before 'Tom Allen and the reporter' and garbles the reporter's question; the tear hides part of it ('Wher... going to get a chance to see Charley'). 'getting jokes' should be 'playing jokes'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, one of Charley Mitchell's trainers, played a joke on a visiting reporter, going in 'to see' about Mitchell and leaving him waiting on the porch while the trainers napped.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Friday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, January 19, 1894.

facts.fact: Allen was one of Charley Mitchell's trainers at his Florida training quarters before the Corbett fight
